description: Design canvases render in a dock under the chat.
agent_instructions: Design canvases render in a dock under the chat. Default to mockups. Ask first about Claude Designer. A card is a whole HTML document: the `<!-- @dsCard group width height -->` marker on line one, then a `<title>` naming the card and a `<meta name="viewport">` whose width matches the declared width. Without that meta, the console uses its 980px default and zooms to fit. A narrower mockup renders as a small island in its own background colour. Fill the page instead of using a surround. A zoom mismatch then becomes a scaled view instead of a blank field.
